method: actual reference and target contact sheets plus official cached target/source fields; not independent blind expert annotation

cases.gourd: Text already returns five visually compatible double-gourd vessels. Diverse references favour decorated variants and introduce elongated single-bulb forms. Keep as a counterexample to automatic improvement.
cases.meiping: All six reference photographs show the rounded shoulder, short neck and tapered body of the meiping family. Chinese rewritten text returns five non-meiping silhouettes. English raw text returns four meiping and one long-neck garden-scene vase. Uniform reference mean returns five meiping-family silhouettes, including four explicitly named in source title/description and a compatible peacock-blue vase.
cases.liao: The three actual Liao references are correct leather-derived vessels. Multireference fusion drifts toward ewers/jars from other dynasties. Source dates disprove these historical matches. Chinese text also retrieves a relevant pair photograph. Keep full failure results.
cases.celadon: References include European gilt mounts, painted enamel and several vase shapes. Both text and reference results are green vessels. References bias towards trumpet-neck forms; no clear gain over text.
cases.dragon: Source-supported references do not reliably show a blue-white dragon on the photographed face. Reference results include floral and polychrome dishes. Text is the stronger route here.
cases.moonflask: No qualified reference photographs acquired. No image matching score is invented.

showcase_selection: meiping chosen after exploratory comparison, not a held-out aggregate estimate

meiping.criterion: visible meiping-family silhouette: short neck/small mouth, rounded broad shoulder, tapering body; source form checked when explicit
